# Search and export

**Status:** accepted

The agreed work includes name search and CSV export. All product and architecture decisions are settled. Inputs are already validated.

## Name search

Add search_items(items, query) to src/app.py. Match names by case-insensitive substring in input order. An empty query returns all items. Search uses Unicode case folding for supported names.

## CSV export

Add export_matches(items, query), calling search_items to select rows before returning CSV text.
Use name,quantity headings, input order, standard csv module quoting, and LF line endings.
Empty matches return a header-only CSV. File writing and interfaces are excluded.
The export ticket depends on the search ticket. All design and ticketing are accepted.

from pathlib import Path
import runpy
app=runpy.run_path(str(Path.cwd()/"src/app.py"))
f=app["search_items"]
rows=[{"name":"Straße lamp","quantity":2},{"name":"Tea","quantity":1},{"name":"STRASSE shade","quantity":3}]
assert f(rows,"strasse")==[rows[0],rows[2]]
assert f(rows,"")==rows and f(rows,"missing")==[] and f([],"x")==[]
assert app["empty_message"]()=="No items saved."
assert app["stock_total"]([{"quantity":-3},{"quantity":5}])==2

assert "export_matches" not in app
